import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Top products by total revenue (bar chart)
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars1 = axes[0, 0].bar(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(product_revenue)))
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 10 Products by Total Revenue', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars1:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[0, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01,
                   f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales distribution by age group and takeaway status (stacked bar chart)
age_takeaway = pd.crosstab(df['customer_age_group'], df['is_takeaway'])
age_takeaway.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_takeaway = age_takeaway.reindex(age_order)
age_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[0, 1], color=['#2E86AB', '#A23B72'])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group and Takeaway Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Service Type')

# 3. Average transaction value by payment method (bar chart with error bars)
payment_stats = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].agg(['mean', 'std', 'count'])
payment_stats['ci'] = 1.96 * payment_stats['std'] / np.sqrt(payment_stats['count'])
bars3 = axes[1, 0].bar(payment_stats.index, payment_stats['mean'], 
                       yerr=payment_stats['ci'], capsize=5, color=sns.color_palette("Set2"))
axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Transaction Value by Payment Method (±95% CI)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=12)
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(payment_stats.iterrows()):
    axes[1, 0].text(i, row['mean'] + row['ci'] + 0.5, f'${row["mean"]:.2f}', 
                   ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 4. Hourly sales pattern (line chart)
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
axes[1, 1].plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, color='#E15554')
axes[1, 1].fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3, color='#E15554')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Hourly Sales Pattern', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
